label: D2 after a1 led commonly to S1 (a1->S1 conjunction), later in episode
explanation: Fires only at D2, and only when the last-action input is a1 and the state input is S1 (a1 with a common transition). Never fires at D1/GO, on a2 trials, or on S2 (rare a1) D2 steps (249 of 52k activations). The conjunction covers 99.5% of activations and ~100% of mass, but only ~40% of a1->S1 D2 steps are active (F1 0.57); restricting to ep_trial >= 20 raises F1 to 0.64 (rate rises steadily over the episode, near zero in trials 0-9). Which a1->S1 steps fire is not captured by reward, previous trial pattern, good state, value or policy logit (all tested, none improve). In example windows the activation tends to be largest on an a1->S1 step right after an unrewarded or rare trial and decays across a run of rewarded a1->S1 trials, but adding prev_reward==0|prev_common==0 hurt recall, so this is only a qualitative trend. All variables are observed at D2.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=D2 & choice_bin=decile 8 (9 = most a1) (+12.74), phase=D2 & choice_bin=decile 7 (9 = most a1) (+5.09), phase=D2 & this=a1 S1 (+3.39), phase=D2 & ep_dec=9 (+3.34), phase=D2 & ep_dec=8 (+2.85), choice_bin=decile 7 (9 = most a1) (+2.75).
